department: Homer L. Dodge Department of Physics and Astronomy

deadline.value: Fall applications are due January 15, 2027; late applications may still be considered if places remain.

app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $100 application fee.
app_fee.quote: pay the application fee ($50 for US applicants and $100 for international applicants)

gre_general.value: The department does not require the general GRE.
gre_general.quote: We do not require general or physics GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require the physics GRE.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require general or physics GRE scores.

supervisor.value: You are admitted to the program first and choose a thesis advisor by mutual agreement later.
supervisor.quote: Students choose their thesis advisor by mutual agreement (typically within the first year or two)

funding.value: All admitted students are offered financial support, usually a TA in the first year.
funding.quote: All admitted students are offered financial support

entry_route.value: Applicants need a US-equivalent bachelor's in physics, astronomy or a closely related field.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have a minimum US equivalent of a BS in Physics, Astronomy or in a closely related field

also.quote: A student should expect to spend at least the equivalent of three full academic years beyond the bachelor’s degree to obtain the doctoral degree

notes: Covers the Physics PhD and the Astrophysics PhD in the same department (astronomy in also_fields). The Engineering Physics PhD is not covered by this page.
